h: Divine Light Emerges Through Suffering and Teshuvah

p: גַּם כִּי אֵלֵךְ וְגוֹ׳ (תְּהִלִּים כג, ד)
the attribute of judgment is not stretched out against him.'
The Holy One, blessed be He, said to him:
'By your life, you have asked for a good thing,
and with you I will begin,' etc.:
'And it came to pass when Yitzchak was old,
that his eyes were dim,' etc." (Bereishis 27:1).
And this is "Even when I walk," etc.,
are for the ultimate good of man,
for through this it becomes clear to man
the Holy One, blessed be He, before their eyes."
And this is "Your rod and Your staff,
"How far does the extent of suffering go?
Even if he put his hand into his purse," etc.
For the rod itself serves as a staff,
like a father who raises the rod over his son
to frighten him for his own good.
וּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג לד, ב)
And in the holy Zohar (on this parsha, Zohar III 34b)
the light of Torah, the light of Gehinnom," etc.
And we must understand what "the light of Gehinnom" means;
after all, on the contrary, they said
so that its smoke is gathered within it,"
and thereby the light is darkened.
that this is only with the sinners of the nations of the world,
but as for the sinners of Yisrael,
as is stated in the Gemara (Eruvin 19a)
"Those who pass through the valley of weeping
that they shed tears like a spring
"You have judged well, You have condemned well";
וְאֵין אוּר שֶׁל גֵּיהִנָּם שׁוֹלֶטֶת בָּהֶם
and the fire of Gehinnom has no dominion over them
for them Gehinnom is for their good,
of the providence of His Divinity, may He be blessed.
As we heard in the name of a certain great man,
who said that he was not afraid
for through it there would become clear to him
the providence of the Creator, blessed be His Name.
that were created before the world;
and it is stated there in the words:
was created on the second day,"
וְהוּא כְּנֶגֶד מִדַּת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and that corresponds to the attribute of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
was created before the creation of the world,
that is, the root of the preparation of the place
וּבְוַדַּאי הֵמָּה נֶגֶד ז׳ מִדּוֹת שֶׁבִּקְדוּשָּׁה
And surely they correspond to the seven attributes of holiness,
and are aligned with the seven shepherds,
according to the order of the enumeration
נֶגֶד מִדָּתוֹ שֶׁל אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the attribute of Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
which corresponds to the first day,
וַיַּרְא אֱלוֹקִים אֶת הָאוֹר כִּי טוֹב
"And God saw the light, that it was good";
the two thousand years of Torah.
נֶגֶד מִדַּת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the attribute of Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
for through the sufferings of Gehinnom
His illumination, may He be blessed, shines for the soul;
and this is what they said (Bereishis Rabbah 65:9):
"and his eyes were too dim to see"
why did his eyes grow dim?
from this Hashem Yisbarach illuminated him
so that he would not stumble,
And the light of Gan Eden
הוּא נֶגֶד מִדַּת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the attribute of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
"See, the fragrance of my son is like the fragrance of a field,"
that Gan Eden entered with him.
The light of the Throne of Glory
הוּא נֶגֶד מִדַּת מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the attribute of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
"He grasps the face of the throne,"
for he took hold of the Throne of Glory
And also King Shlomo, peace be upon him,
who was in the aspect of Moshe
נֶאֱמַר בּוֹ (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים א כט, כג)
it says of him (Divrei HaYamim I 29:23):
וַיֵּשֶׁב שְׁלֹמֹה עַל כִּסֵּא ה׳ וְגוֹ׳
"And Shlomo sat on the throne of Hashem," etc.
And the light of the Beis HaMikdash
"And from the Sanctuary he shall not go out."
corresponds to the attribute of Yosef HaTzaddik;
for it is for this that the main rectification is needed:
for the blemish of the bris;
and through this it branched out
who are born with a covering foreskin,
"Since milah was given on the eighth,"
for this matter requires healing and rectification
in the totality of the souls of Yisrael;
"And He will heal the wound of the blow of the world."
And this corresponds to the sixth day,
but that which comes out of the darkness,
כִּדְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קפד, א)
as is stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 184a).
And for this the month of Adar is suited,
which corresponds to the tribe of Yosef,
as is stated in the holy sefarim;
וְחוֹדֶשׁ זֶה יֵשׁ לוֹ ב׳ אֲדָרִים
and this month has two Adars,
who was divided into two tribes.
That is, for the rectification of the blemish of the bris,
which is the opposing force in this month,
as is stated in Sefer Yetzirah:
and in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 148b):
and her letter is Kuf," etc.,
which follows after human beings," etc.
that is, it has in appearance
And when one merits to clarify this in the month of Adar,
one comes afterward to the month of Nissan,
which is the illumination of the light of Mashiach;
corresponds to the attribute of Malchus,
David, King of Yisrael, who lives and endures,
when he was living and enduring;
and this corresponds to the holiness of the day of Shabbos,
which is a semblance of the World to Come.
